annotations.title: Risk report: every flag three-valued, with source

description:
What this property is in, and whether we actually checked: every
    designation and hazard flag THREE-VALUED with its source — flood (zone,
    historic flooding, defences, rivers-and-sea band, surface water), coal
    (high-risk area, past mining, surface hazard distance), heritage (listed,
    conservation area, scheduled monument, registered park, battlefield,
    World Heritage), environmental (AONB, national park, green belt, SSSI, NNR,
    ancient woodland, nutrient neutrality, SAC, Ramsar, LNR), planning
    (Article 4, TPO, brownfield register) and infrastructure (nearest
    substation distance, voltage and demand headroom, nearest renewable
    project). `true` and `checked_false` are verdicts; `defaulted_false` and
    `not_checked` are not — say which when you report it.
    UK only. Costs 5 credits (5p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_risk_report
